request: Build two reusable recorded-payment reports for reconciliation. Source is the fictional Jaffle Shop demo. Required customer_summary: every customers.id exactly once, columns customer_id INTEGER, recorded_dollars numeric, payment_records INTEGER; sum all payment rows attached through orders.user_id, divide cents by 100.0, zero for customers with no payments. Required method_summary: each observed payment_method exactly once with columns method TEXT, recorded_dollars numeric, payment_records INTEGER. Include all recorded amounts and statuses; do NOT infer refunds, order prices, unpaid balances, or revenue recognition. Equal-valued payment records remain distinct. Order outputs ascending by customer_id/method. IDs are non-null unique; payment order IDs and order user IDs exist; amounts are non-null nonnegative integer cents. Promised reusable behavior is tested on small alternate valid inputs including zero/equal payments, returned orders and no-payment customers.

units.description: Produce a reusable payment-row relation with order/customer association; preserve each recorded payment.
Implement customer_summary; may consume shared_base with exact version binding.
Implement method_summary; may consume shared_base with exact version binding.
Implement all required outputs together from original sources.
